cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

mechanism: A rules on whether an apology settles the matter, then directs repair of the deeper omission revealed by B response.
confusable: Distinguish demanding repeated sorry from identifying a second specific injury beyond the first conceded offense.
comparison: Concert scene concerns emotional silence after absence; vase scene concerns concealed blame assigned to an innocent dog.
seedUse: Use canonical concert and vase layers, with S01 in A control of settlement; do not assume historical single acceptance settles pair fidelity.
